name: Liaozhai Lian: Yingning
source:
Late Tang turmoil unleashes ghosts and fiends, turning the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan and Yun into a haunted wasteland. Play as a general’s second son, journeying south with your ghost elder sister and fox-spirit younger sister for the fabled paradise. Will you find it?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5019890/Strange_Tales_from_a_Chinese_Studio_2_Fox_Sister/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
晚唐乱世，群魔乱舞，魑魅魍魉横行人间，令燕云十六州沦为一片百鬼夜行的荒原。你将扮演将门世家的次子，带着化为鬼魂的姐姐与身为狐妖的妹妹一路南下，追寻传说中的世外桃源。你们最终能否寻得那片乐土？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5019890/Strange_Tales_from_a_Chinese_Studio_2_Fox_Sister/]Steam[/url]]
